topic: What is Elucera? Turn any question into a captioned 60-second animated explainer reel
narration: You ask something tricky, like black holes or blockchains. Reading takes forever. And most explainers are too long or too vague. You just want the clear answer, fast.
description: Split comparison shot. Left panel (x 8-46%, y 18-72%): dim grey article card with dense muted text lines, title 'Black Holes Explained' + author row, scrolling upward continuously. Right panel (x 54-92%, y 18-72%): clean vertical player card with cyan border, play icon, progress bar accent cyan at bottom of card, timer counter '0:60'. Center VS badge. Background dark. Accent red X stamps for too long/vague. Good green check for clear answer.

beats.action: Split layout slides in; left article card fades in with question bubble 'black holes or blockchains?' above it.
Article title highlights to 'BLACK HOLES'; second chip 'blockchains' pops accent2 on left card.
Left article scrolls fast upward endlessly; clock icon spins; word FOREVER stamps red.
Two red badges slam on left: 'TOO LONG' and 'TOO VAGUE'; left card dims to muted grey.
Right player brightens with green check; words CLEAR ANSWER pop white inside player; progress bar starts filling.
Right progress bar races 0-100% in cyan with speed lines and '60s' counter ticking fast; left stays stalled.
